commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
SERIAL="$(PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m aicall_tools.device.s22_adb_discovery --serial RFCT70L7E8J)"
adbq() { adb -s "$SERIAL" "$@"; }
MAIN=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge
LAB=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.s8lab
test "$(adbq shell am get-current-user | tr -d '\r')" = 0
check_safe() {
  local states mode role host
  states="$(adbq shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | tr -d '\r')"
  mode="$(adbq shell dumpsys audio | sed -n 's/.*Actual mode = \(MODE_[A-Z_]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d '\r')"
  role="$(adbq shell cmd role get-role-holders --user 0 android.app.role.DIALER | tr -d '\r')"
  host="$(adbq shell content call --uri content://pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.gsmbinder --method status)"
  [[ -n "$states" && -z "$(printf '%s\n' "$states" | grep -v '^0$' || true)" && "$mode" == MODE_NORMAL && "$role" == "$MAIN" && "$host" == *host_registered=true* ]]
}
check_safe || { echo HOLD_PHONE_OR_MAIN_HOST_NOT_READY; exit 50; }
before="$(adbq shell pm path --user 0 "$MAIN" | tr -d '\r')"
[[ "$before" == package:* ]]
packages="$(adbq shell pm list packages --user 0 | tr -d '\r')"
[[ "$packages" == *"package:$MAIN"* ]]
if printf '%s\n' "$packages" | grep -Fxq "package:$LAB"; then
  check_safe
  result="$(adbq shell pm uninstall --user 0 "$LAB" | tr -d '\r')"
  [[ "$result" == Success ]] || { echo LAB_UNINSTALL_FAILED; exit 51; }
  echo LAB_UNINSTALL_EXECUTED=true
else
  echo LAB_ALREADY_ABSENT_USER0=true
fi
packages="$(adbq shell pm list packages --user 0 | tr -d '\r')"
if printf '%s\n' "$packages" | grep -Fxq "package:$LAB"; then
  echo LAB_STILL_INSTALLED_USER0=true; exit 52
fi
echo LAB_ABSENT_USER0=true
test "$(adbq shell pm path --user 0 "$MAIN" | tr -d '\r')" = "$before"
check_safe
echo MAIN_GSM_HOST_READY=true
result="$(adbq shell content call --uri content://pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.gsmbinder --method qa_status)"
if [[ "$result" == *armed=true* ]]; then echo QA_ARMED=true; elif [[ "$result" == *armed=false* ]]; then echo QA_ARMED=false; else echo QA_ARMED_UNKNOWN=true; fi
echo NO_CALLS=true
